title: Sebastian Area Historical Society

services.name: Collections & Exhibits
services.desc: A visit to the Sebastian Area Historical Museum is your opportunity to take a journey into the past. These collections bring to life the rich heritage of our area. The Ais Indians lived here and left behind their shells and pottery which were found and donated. Treasure ships foundered off the coast, and some of the objects that were recovered are exhibited. Implements of the farming and fishing industries that were the mainstays of the early economy are displayed. The rich soil and abundant wildlife provided enormous harvests that were sent north for profit. Reminders of the boats on the waterways, and then later, the railroad that sent these harvests north are here. Pioneer family life
